newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers gets new Cefzil indication.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers gets new Cefzil indication.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said on Thursday it had received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its oral antibiotic Cefzil for a new indication -- the treatment of acute bacterial sinusitis in adult and pediatric patients.
This makes Cefzil the only cephalosporin approved for both sinusitis and otitis media in pediatric patients, Bristol-Myers said.
Introduced in 1992, Cefzil is used to treat infections caused by susceptible strains of designated microorganisms in upper and lower respiratory tract infections and skin infections.
